title: ageratina viburnoides
intro: Ageratina viburnoides, commonly known as White Top or Mountain Silverbell, is a flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential to help manage fever, colds, and respiratory issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina viburnoides include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it a popular choice for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ageratina viburnoides include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
